svg.text: Menhir (the oval with a bowed back)
56 W x 53 D x 108 H mm (lid included); flat foot 54 x 47; shell ~44 cm3, ~151 g with board 30 g + battery 55 g (assumed)
centre of mass 29 behind the foot's front edge, 50 up; tips at ~20° back / 29° forward (worst direction 20°); tilt15: 22 / 29, oval: 18 / 17
The calm one: every section the oval's superellipse, 56 wide; front 15°; the back is one slow concave bow, vertical at the desk, 6° back at the top, so the top
overhangs the foot by 5 and the body reads as leaning, not as a wedge. Flat top 42 x 12, R7. 3 less base depth than the wedge (a), ~3° less tipping margin.
1 mm = 4 px, grid 10 mm. Blue-grey: stack box s 12..95 (along the face from the rim), t 3..26; dashed in it: real board+glass and battery. Blue: rods 8 x 66.65 at x ±10.23. Red: CoM, flat foot.
